newsitem.title: USA: Maytag launches 2 new floor care products.
newsitem.headline: Maytag launches 2 new floor care products.

text.p: Maytag Corp's said Monday its Hoover division is introducing two new floor care products, which will be available at retail sale in the third quarter.

The new products are the Hoover WindTunnel upright vacuum cleaner line, which features technology patented by Hoover to improve cleaning performance, and the Hoover SteamVac Ultra, which is a top-end addition to the company's highly successful extractor line, Maytag said.

"Profitable growth is Maytag's number one objective. Our strategy to achieve that objective includes ongoing investments in new products with improved design and demonstrable consumer benefits," Maytag Chairman Leonard Hadley said in a statement. "Hoover's new products are a prime example of that strategy in action."
Maytag said the WindTunnel represents a significant investment in new technology, adding television advertising to back the product will focus its "superior cleaning ability."
It added that the SteamVac Ultra has features not found on any other extractor.

The new Hoover products are the latest in a number of other new product initiatives by Maytag business units. Among them are totally redesigned lines of Maytag, Jenn-Air, Magic Chef and Admiral refrigerators; the new Maytag high-efficiency, horizontal axis washer and matching dryer, and redesigned Dixie-Narco soft drink vending machines.
Maytag also is marketing a line of large, multiple-load commercial washers sourced from Primus, a Belgian manufacturer.
According to Hadley, the corporation has other product changes planned for the second half of 1997 and into 1998.
Maytag Corporation produces major home appliances.
